title: Chicken Tikka Masala
subtitle: Charred yoghurt-marinated chicken in spiced tomato and cream sauce
excerpt: Chicken pieces marinated in spiced yoghurt and grilled until charred at the edges, then finished in a rich, mildly spiced tomato and cream sauce. Britain's unofficial national dish, with roots in South Asian tandoori cooking adapted for Western kitchens.

recipe.sourceNotes: Chicken tikka masala is of disputed origin, most plausibly a British-South Asian invention of the 1960s or 1970s, though Glasgow, London, and Punjab have all claimed credit. The dish begins with chicken tikka, which is genuinely Indian: chicken pieces marinated in spiced yoghurt and cooked in a tandoor oven. The masala sauce is a British adaptation, reportedly created to appeal to customers who wanted a wetter, saucier dish than the dry tikka. The sauce varies enormously between restaurants; the defining characteristics are tomato, cream or coconut milk, and warming spices including garam masala, cumin, and coriander. The grilling step for the tikka is essential for flavour: the char on the chicken is what distinguishes the finished dish from a plain chicken curry.

content.text: Marinate the chicken for at least 2 hours; overnight is better. The char from grilling or griddling is not optional: it provides the smoky, caramelised notes that define the dish. Add the cream at the end and do not boil after adding it, or the sauce will thin.

items.preparation: boneless, skinless; cut into large chunks

content.text: Mix the yoghurt with the ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin, coriander, turmeric, chilli powder, paprika, and a generous pinch of salt. Add the chicken and turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Thread the chicken onto skewers or arrange on a foil-lined tray. Grill under a very hot grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until charred in patches and cooked through.

Heat the oil in a large pan. Cook the onion over medium heat for 10 minutes until deep golden. Add the tomato puree and cook for 2 minutes. Add the tinned tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Simmer for 15 minutes until thick and reduced.
Add the grilled chicken to the sauce. Stir in the cream. Simmer gently for 5 minutes. Taste and adjust salt. Serve with basmati rice and naan, scattered with fresh coriander.
